nodes.label: Backend Agent Definition (iot-back-implementador)
nodes.description: Claude agent definition for Laravel 12 backend implementation. Defines conventions: controllers call application services, services own model/domain transitions, observers own side effects. G0D ownership consolidation rule. AlertService is alert-rule evaluation owner. DeviceService handles device transitions. EventServiceProvider centralizes wiring. Redis Streams are the durable event backbone. Three rate limit tiers: api-read (120/min), api-write (60/min), auth-login (5/min).
nodes.rationale: Establishes the backend agent's conventions and ownership rules for the IoT platform. Defines the architectural layering (controllers → services → models → observers → events) and the G0D consolidation gate that precedes all implementation.
